text: いつでも　ポケモンの　だしいれが　じゆうに　できる　なんて　べんりな　よのなかだね

structure.jp: いつでも　ポケモンの　だしいれが　じゆうに　できる　なんて
structure.en: to think you can freely put in and take out Pokémon at any time

structure.jp: べんりな　よのなかだね
structure.en: it's a convenient world, isn't it

patterns.name: 〜なんて
patterns.explanation: なんて after a statement shows the speaker is amazed by it, like 'to think that...'. できる　なんて = 'to think that you can do it'.

patterns.name: 〜ができる
patterns.span: だしいれが　じゆうに　できる
patterns.explanation: A thing followed by が and できる says that the thing can be done. だしいれが　じゆうに　できる = 'you can put them in and take them out freely'.
